# assessment score value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assessmentScoreValue`](gmeow-assessmentScoreValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessmentScoreValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The numeric score, on the scale the criterion or rubric declares. Functional and mandatory (SHACL). A datatype twin of [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) (which is entity-valued — the [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) pattern); zeros are scores, never absences (false positives are worse than zeros).
